request: Replace the rock-like central berm with a smooth steep hill that can cause an effortful climbing stall; repeat the four-route media validation.

geometry_development.selection_basis: Physical shape and Chrono outcome probes only; no model-score-based geometry search.
geometry_development.intent: Broad continuous hill, gradual toe and crest, no narrow near-vertical mesa wall.
geometry_development.preferred_choice: A less severe smooth slope producing sustained effortful failure while leaving a safe detour.
geometry_development.controls: Keep vehicle, friction, powertrain, native PID, start, goal and six reference families fixed; disclose any necessary scene-footprint change.
geometry_development.diagnostics: Retain all probes; inspect measured pitch, height, effort, progress, wheel behavior and chassis/terrain clearance or contact evidence.
geometry_development.interpretation: Asset contact absence alone cannot exclude underbody terrain blocking. Report only failure mechanisms supported by telemetry.

final_validation.initial_observation: Generate actual current RGB-D and measured vehicle context on the selected hill.
final_validation.planner: Existing RGB-D checkpoint and MPPI scorer/config; 4 s horizon; 6 m/s command ceiling; seed 11.
final_validation.freeze: Save all model forecasts and four references before the final four recorded executions.
final_validation.scope: Scene was intentionally selected using prior geometry probes; not an untouched test or unbiased benchmark.
final_validation.risk_policy: Preserve actual probabilities and any prediction failures; do not label hypotheses as positive model classifications.
